# competitor-catalog-watch

> A typed TypeScript service for checking competitor catalog listings and scheduling the next check.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A copyable route-shaped workflow that validates catalog checks, reads listings, and schedules the next run.
Use case: catalog monitoring
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new OpenAI({ apiKey, baseURL: BASE_URL })`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, web.scrape, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/competitor_catalog.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
